name: 57718 · Black Hawk, SD
findings: ZIP 57718 (Black Hawk) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57718 (Black Hawk) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
